scope: Research the unresolved AC1018/R2004 inline modeler-v2 SAB extraction boundary, cross-check it against primary DWG guidance, and screen a newly surfaced clean-room DWG reader for bounded optional comparison use.

method.kind: Local authoritative ODA specification inspection plus public primary project/API documentation and local source/plan inspection
sourcesReviewed: Local /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf, ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.41 printed pp.144-145 and §24
method.evidenceBoundary: ODA v5.4.1 is authoritative for the DWG entity-envelope boundary, not arbitrary ACIS grammar or B-rep validity. Public ACadRust and ODA SDK docs corroborate the R2004 no-length/version-conversion lead but do not substitute for a successful exact AC1018 source trace. cadkit-dwg is a candidate only: its own docs disclose partial modeler decoding, no DWG writer, growing coverage, and ACadSharp-derived R2007 container logic; exact package-to-source identity was not resolved or executed.

sources: DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md S3.2 existing AC1018 negative-only probe
findings.observed: ODA §20.4.41 says modeler version 2 carries an inline ACIS file with no length: the signature distinguishes SAB from SAT, SAB ends at a tagged End-of-ACIS-data marker, and later wireframe/silhouette/transform data plus common handles follow separately. ACadRust explicitly notes R2004-R2006 DWGs embed SAB without a length prefix. ODA ModelerGeometry API documentation says a 2004 DWG saved to R15 DXF must convert SAB to SAT version 700. Current libdxfrw extracts version-2 inline SAB for AC1021/AC1024, but the existing AC1018 local probe remains negative-only and has no separately extracted payload/source-version identity.
doesNotEstablish: a positive exact-source AC1018 payload extraction or independent owner association
that every AC1018 producer uses the same version-2 inline payload variant
general SAT/SAB grammar, shape validity, topology, dimensions, or B-rep semantics
permission to merge wireframe/silhouette/tail bytes into the ACIS payload
findings.planUse: Refine existing S3.2/S3.4 with a bounded AC1018 no-length version-2 extraction slice and generated framing tests. Keep AC1018 VERSION_WITNESS_REQUIRED until a successful source-bound trace and independent boundary corroboration pass; do not change the writer/support gate.

findings.observed: The docs.rs 0.3.0 package documentation describes a clean-room R13-2018 reader and native/raw-object view. The current repository README and format notes instead describe AC1014-AC1032 and explicitly mark AC1012/R13 untested; the repository changelog's latest visible entry is 0.2.1, so the exact published-crate/source revision relationship is unresolved. The repository format notes classify REGION/3DSOLID/BODY as partial modeler-header/SAT-v1-size decoding and say there is no DWG writer. The provenance file identifies ACadSharp as a cross-check/sample source and identifies its R2007 LZ77 decompressor/container flow as ACadSharp-derived. The repository declares 0.x API instability and growing entity coverage.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS body extraction, AcDs association, semantic solid support, or DWG writing
full implementation independence from ACadSharp for R2007 container behavior
which source revision and version claim the published docs.rs 0.3.0 artifact actually represents
runtime results on libdxfrw-generated or locally generated files
findings.planUse: Add to discovery-only optional structural DWG peer inventory. Before any composed comparison, pin the crate checksum, source commit, lockfile, build profile and artifact/source relationship; reconcile the R13/AC1012 documentation discrepancy, report its ACadSharp-derived R2007 lineage, and never count it as an ACIS or kernel semantic vote.

implementationReadiness: Add no-length AC1018 modeler-version-2 positive and missing/truncated/duplicate/non-SAB/empty negatives to an existing generated test owner; assert suffix, handle, and neighboring-record boundaries.
Keep a complete-marker ambiguity opaque unless token-aware parsing is supported by ACIS grammar evidence; do not weaken the unique-marker guard speculatively.
Use an existing local AC1018 sample only as an untracked trace input if provenance permits; otherwise retain generated from-scratch controls and the VERSION_WITNESS_REQUIRED state.
At a composed checkpoint, optional ODA R15 conversion can corroborate SAB-to-SAT-700 route behavior but is not a raw-byte equality or semantic-solid test.
Admit cadkit-dwg only as an optional structural reader after immutable artifact/source pinning; do not add it to CI or per-slice validation.
